description: Use this when the user asks how many minutes an NBA player should play tonight, who gets more minutes or shots when a teammate is out, or what a player is expected to score, rebound and assist tonight. Returns tonight's games with each team's players: the minutes they have been playing, the minutes expected after the injury report and how much the absences move them, usage, who is out and the minutes he frees; with Keel Stats Pro also expected points, rebounds and assists, the chances of reaching a number, the team both ways around each player in doubt, and with a player_id who gained when he sat. `account.held` names what the caller's plan left out. Not for past games: use player_profile.

game_id.description: Optional numeric game ID from tonight_slate: that game alone.

league.description: League: "nba" (the NFL has no minutes model).

player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID from search: his team tonight, and who gained when he sat.

team_id.description: Optional numeric team ID from search: that team's side alone.

name: stat_forecasts
title: Tonight's Minutes & Expected Stats
